title.en: Serving customers at a massage salon

summary.ja: コースや時間を案内して、力加減を確かめ、施術のあとのアドバイスを伝える。
summary.en: Explain the treatments, check the pressure and give advice afterwards.

setting: A relaxation salon near a busy shopping street in Tokyo, in the early evening. A tourist who has been walking all day comes in; the staff speak English to them.

roles.persona: A member of staff at the relaxation salon.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist who has walked a lot today. Open by walking in and looking at the menu by the door; wait for the staff to greet you. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. You'd like a foot massage. During the massage, when the staff asks about the pressure, say it's a little strong.

hints: あいさつして、どのマッサージがいいか聞きましょう
Hello! Which … would you like?
Hello! Which massage would you like?

title.ja: コースの長さと料金を伝える

hints: メニューを見て、コースの長さと料金を伝えましょう
It's … minutes, … yen.
It's 30 minutes, 3,000 yen.

title.en: Ask them to take off their shoes

hints: 靴を脱いでもらいましょう
Please take off …
Please take off your shoes here.
強さがちょうどいいか聞きましょう
Is the pressure …?
Is the pressure okay?

levels.tutor: You are a tourist, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. You have about an hour before dinner. Open by walking in and asking what kind of massages they have. Ask what the head and shoulder massage is like, but choose the 60-minute body massage. Say yes if the staff offers aroma oil.

hints: 何分のコースがいいか聞きましょう
How long would you like? We have …
How long would you like? We have 30 or 60 minutes.
頭と肩のマッサージがどんなものか説明しましょう
The head and shoulder massage is good for … It's …
The head and shoulder massage is good for stiff shoulders. It's 20 minutes.

title.ja: アロマオイルをすすめる

hints: アロマオイルを追加するか聞きましょう
Would you like to add …? It's …
Would you like to add aroma oil? It's 500 yen extra.
着替えと更衣室の場所を伝えましょう
Please change into … The changing room is …
Please change into these clothes. The changing room is on the left.
オイル代も入れた合計を伝えましょう
That's … in total.
That's 7,000 yen in total.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist, speaking at natural speed with small talk. You've been walking around all day and your legs and shoulders are tired. Open by walking in and saying you'd like a massage; wait for the staff to ask what you need. Take the staff's recommendation. After the massage, say you feel much better.

title.ja: お客さんの希望を聞く

hints: 特にほぐしたい場所があるか聞きましょう
Is there any part of your body you'd like us to …?
Is there any part of your body you'd like us to focus on?

title.ja: 理由をつけてコースをすすめる
title.en: Recommend a treatment, with a reason

hints: 理由も添えて、合うコースをすすめましょう
I'd recommend … It covers …
I'd recommend the 60-minute body massage. It covers your legs and shoulders.

title.ja: 施術中に様子を確かめる

hints: 強さを確かめて、痛かったら言ってと伝えましょう
How's the …? Please let me know if …
How's the pressure? Please let me know if anything hurts.

title.ja: 施術後のアドバイスをする

hints: 水を飲んでゆっくり休むようすすめましょう
Please drink … and …
Please drink some water and take it easy tonight.

twist.tutor: Before the massage starts, mention that your lower back is a little sore: you hurt it lifting your suitcase yesterday. It's not serious, but you're worried about the massage. Ask whether it's okay.

hints: 腰はさけて施術すると伝えて、安心してもらいましょう
Thank you for telling me. We'll … your lower back today.
Thank you for telling me. We'll avoid your lower back today.

roles.persona: A tourist visiting a relaxation salon in Tokyo.

levels.tutor: You are the salon staff. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Greet the customer and ask which massage they'd like. When asked, say the price from the menu. During the massage, ask once if the pressure is okay, and change it when they ask.

title.ja: 受けたいコースを伝える

hints: 受けたいマッサージを伝えましょう
A …, please.
A foot massage, please.
料金を聞きましょう
How much is …?
How much is the foot massage?
もう少し弱くしてもらいましょう
A bit …, please.
A bit softer, please.
お礼を言いましょう
Thank you. That was …
Thank you. That was great!

levels.tutor: You are the salon staff, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. Ask how long they'd like. When asked, recommend a treatment from the menu and mention the aroma oil option (+¥500). During the massage, ask once about the pressure.

title.ja: 時間を伝えておすすめを聞く

hints: 時間を伝えて、おすすめを聞きましょう
I have about … What do you …?
I have about an hour. What do you recommend?
受けたいコースとオプションを伝えましょう
I'll have the … with …
I'll have the 60-minute body massage with aroma oil.

title.ja: 重点的にほぐしてほしい場所を伝える
title.en: Ask them to focus on an area

hints: 肩をよくほぐしてほしいと伝えましょう
Could you focus on …? They're …
Could you focus on my shoulders? They're really stiff.
もう少し強くしてもらいましょう
Could you make it a bit …?
Could you make it a bit stronger, please?

levels.tutor: You are the salon staff, speaking at natural speed, kind and professional. Ask about the customer's needs and recommend a treatment from the menu. When they mention a problem, thank them for telling you, adjust the treatment (stay away from that area completely) and ask them to tell you if anything hurts. After the massage, suggest drinking some water.

hints: 一日歩いて、足が疲れていると伝えましょう
I've been … all day, and my … are …
I've been walking all day, and my legs are really tired.
腰が少し痛いと伝えて、大丈夫か聞きましょう
Also, my lower back is a bit … Is that …?
Also, my lower back is a bit sore. Is that a problem?

title.ja: 腰はさけてほしいとお願いする
title.en: Ask them to avoid that area

hints: 腰はさけてほしいとお願いしましょう
Could you … my lower back, please?
Could you avoid my lower back, please?

title.ja: 感想を伝えてお礼を言う
title.en: Thank them and say how you feel

hints: 感想を伝えてお礼を言いましょう
That was … I feel …
That was wonderful. I feel so much better.

items.name: Clothes to change into are provided · changing room on the left
Sore back or an injury? Please tell us before we start
Please take off your shoes at the entrance
